Internal: the group comparison's front, from the pipeline to the groups

Source: R/compare.R
dot-jst_group_front.Rd

jt() and jaov() each held this block (Session 386, the twin build): the data pipeline, the formula's variables and transforms, the duplicate, dummy-outcome and type checks, the Case Processing block and the empty-sample stop, then the grouping variable made a factor of its groups. A group is counted on the cases the test can use (count_on_outcome), as jaov() always and jt() for an independent test (Session 346).

Usage

.jst_group_front(
  formula,
  data,
  .jst_data_name,
  .jst_default_used,
  subset_expr,
  envir,
  case.processing.detail,
  fn,
  noun,
  count_on_outcome
)

Arguments

formula, data

The call's formula and data frame.

.jst_data_name, .jst_default_used

The data frame's name and whether it is the juse() default.

subset_expr

The call's subset = expression (substitute(subset)).

envir

The calling frame (parent.frame()).

case.processing.detail

The call's setting.

fn

Character(1): the calling function.

noun

Character(1): "a t-test" or "an ANOVA".

count_on_outcome

Logical(1): drop a group's cases missing on the outcome before the groups are counted.

Value

A list: data, formula, terms, dv_name, group_name, lab_src, mf, sample_info, n_groups_data, is_labelled, original_codes, group_val_labels (the last two NULL when the group is not labelled).
